name: What factors influence the cost of deck restoration?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of deck restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of deck restoration is influenced by several factors, including the deck's size, its current condition, the type of wood, the extent of repairs needed, and the chosen finish. Decks requiring extensive board replacement or significant structural repairs will incur higher costs than those needing only cleaning and a fresh coat of stain. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed estimate after an on-site assessment, ensuring all factors specific to your Dublin or Fremont property are considered.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include deck size, condition, wood type, repair extent, and chosen finish, with larger or more damaged decks costing more.
